moments.title: Home-cooked, every day
moments.copy: Menus planned with residents each month, baking on Wednesdays, and a proper Sunday roast.

moments.title: The garden room
moments.copy: Raised beds, a greenhouse and tea outside whenever the weather allows — gardening is Oakfield's favourite pastime.

moments.title: Music and memory
moments.copy: Weekly singalongs, visiting musicians and playlists built from each resident's own era and taste.

moments.title: Out and about
moments.copy: Minibus trips to the river, garden centres and the theatre — life doesn't stop at the front door.
